resources.string: Asks you to approve when someone wants to listen to this phone\'s microphone.
%1$s wants to listen to this phone\'s microphone. Tap to choose, or ignore to decline.
%1$s will hear this phone\'s microphone live and can record short audio clips until you tap Stop.
Each session needs you to approve it on the phone; the microphone can\'t be opened unattended. While it is shared a notification with Stop stays visible.
Allow microphone access so the web Microphone tab can ask to use it.
